#BABYMONSTER You mean *BATTER UP* — BABYMONSTER's monster debut, and yeah it's a whole statement.

BATTER UP came out November 27, 2023 as YG's first girl group debut in 7 years since BLACKPINK, and it's literally what an umpire shouts in baseball when the next batter has to get in the box — meaning "it's my turn now, get ready." That's the whole concept. YG said it was a song filled with bold confidence and ambition to mark the beginning, a powerful hip-hop track that imprints their unique presence.

Lyrically it's not a sweet love song at all. They open with "I'm on a mission, don't need permission / No matter what, I'm gonna make my own decisions" and then flip it — "Remember me, sting like a bee / Personality like a starving lion / I would never do you wrong / You'll regret it when I'm gone." They say they're pretty and kind but warn you they can turn into a monster, that they are the monsters of the world. Ruka holding a baseball bat in the MV while she raps, Asa burning the stage, Chiquita, Rami, Rora, Pharita all chanting "batter batter batter up" like a rally cry.

It's empowerment but with fangs — run, run, run, never can stop, hit a home run, get out of my way, MVP energy. It debuted at #1 on iTunes in 14 countries, 8.69 million views in 10 hours, and it basically told the whole industry: we didn't come to be cute, we came to be unforgettable.
